post.title: Retaining Wall Mukilteo WA — When a Wall Needs a Permit, Steep-Slope Critical Areas, Drainage and Engineering
post.description: A Mukilteo homeowner's guide to building a retaining wall on a sloped lot: when the City requires an engineering permit, how landslide-hazard critical areas and geotechnical reports come in, drainage behind the wall, block, concrete and timber options, and how to vet the contractor.
